prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic poolside vacation portrait beneath a straw umbrella.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with fair freckled skin, vibrant red hair in a high messy bun, calm direct gaze and minimal natural makeup, reclining on a wicker lounge chair wearing a mint-green triangle bikini with thin straps and chunky gold necklace; natural skin texture and fine-line tattoos visible as in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait with face and upper body sharp, hand resting against cheek, wicker chair and cushion foreground, turquoise pool, resort architecture, palms and thatched umbrella behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overhead natural daylight filtered by straw, gentle shadows, warm inviting peaceful vacation atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR 50mm lens look at f/2.8, slight depth-of-field background blur, high-definition realistic skin, vibrant but natural blues, greens and warm tones.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical ultra-photorealistic resort poolside portrait of one generic approved adult freckled woman with vibrant red hair in a high messy bun, reclining on a wicker lounge chair beneath a thatched umbrella, hand resting at cheek, wearing a mint-green triangle bikini and chunky gold necklace, turquoise pool and beige resort architecture with palms behind, soft natural daylight and serene summer elegance; preserve visible reference tattoos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay

assets.name: redhead-poolside-summer.jpg
assets.usage: Match approved adult identity, freckles, hair, tattoos, mint bikini, pose, lounge chair, resort, umbrella and light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve face, hair, freckles, tattoos, outfit, pose, environment, composition and lighting. Jewelry and architecture are replaceable; keep the pose non-explicit and avoid celebrity likeness or overlay text.

changes: Normalized schema and removed body-emphasis wording while preserving the original poolside concept.
